name: Desperate and Dateless
source:
Donna, a fully grown witch of 26, decided that today would be the day she pulled a stupid act. Trying her best not to be caught in a lie, Donna frantically searches for a date to the Winter Formal. A dance she wasn't even attending for fun but to chaperon a bunch of tweens at—all for free out of her love for her students. 

Donna has no idea why she put herself in this situation but hopefully, she is able to drag herself out of this easily avoidable pit she put herself into.

Will she be able to find a date, or will she get made fun of by a group of little tween witches?

What will kill her, Romance? Or that feeling of embarrassment she can't escape from?

This visual novel was made for the Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022.

[Edited from [url=https://tiredbunni.itch.io/desperateanddateless]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
26岁的成年女巫唐娜，偏偏在今天干了一件蠢事。为了不让自己的谎言被戳穿，唐娜焦头烂额地四处寻找舞伴，好一起参加冬季正式舞会——况且她去参加这场舞会甚至不是为了消遣，纯粹是因为疼爱学生，才义务去给一群十来岁的孩子们当监护人。

唐娜也不知道自己为什么要自讨苦吃，但愿她能把自己从这个原本完全可以避免的泥潭里拉出来。

她究竟能找到舞伴，还是会被一群十来岁的小女巫们嘲笑呢？

最终会要了她命的，究竟是恋爱，还是那份无处可逃的尴尬？

这部视觉小说是为2022年冬季视觉小说创作赛（Winter Visual Novel Jam 2022）而制作的。

[整编自[url=https://tiredbunni.itch.io/desperateanddateless]Itch.io[/url]]
